d: Over the last few years, a string of high-profile terror commanders and fugitives have been systematically eliminated across major Pakistani cities like Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, and Sialkot. From IC-814 hijacker Zahoor Mistry and Pathankot mastermind Shahid Latif to Paramjeet Singh Panjwar, more than 30 key operatives have been targeted and neutralized by unidentified operatives.
